scope: Portable continuation of the reviewed foundation and north-star catalog. This is a research queue over retained evidence, not an unattended runner or a new-host acceptance receipt.

saturation.meaning: A finite candidate set can be exhausted for a frozen requirement and date. This does not establish universal superiority or permanently exhaust an evolving field.
close_only_when: Every required layer has a selected choice, named alternatives and recoverable primary evidence.
The frozen candidate/source set is recorded, including failed access and explicit omitted/out-of-scope reasons.
Required representative comparisons and target-host lifecycle checks meet preregistered acceptance; missing evidence remains open.
A second independent review identifies no unresolved material gap in that bounded set.
A dated closure record lists residual risks, untested boundaries and exact reopening triggers.
reopen_on: Changed task, dataset, hardware, platform or deployment requirement
A maintained challenger with a demonstrated missing capability
A retained failure, incompatible release or materially changed source/license
A fresh representative comparison overturns a selection

resume_order: Read AGENTS.md, adoption/manifest.json and this small queue; preserve local changes and record the checkout commit.
Choose one layer and read its current comparison, source pins, actual receipts and this next action.
On a new PC establish the selected profile and scoped native discovery/task behavior before reusing any local acceptance claim.
Search current primary sources and the named starred/awesome-list inventories for that gap; inspect original upstream code/docs.
Use one bounded candidate comparison with frozen inputs/criteria and independent review; preserve failures, complete native metadata and raw recovery.
Update the affected canonical decision and queue; regenerate the existing index/HTML, verify integrity and inspect published checks.

execution_policy.credential_transfer: native sign-in on destination; never copy authentication stores
execution_policy.worker_context: Only the task, owned paths, selected skill sections, source pins and acceptance/effect boundary.
execution_policy.memory: Versioned public task records carry portable evidence; project-scoped ai-memory carries private continuity. Neither transfers runtime acceptance.

layers.next_action: Compare a native client and supported SDK only for a missing event, tool or recovery requirement; freeze identical task/account/effect checks.
Use a selected pinned skill on its matching task; retain discovery, loaded sections, concrete findings and baseline conflict/effort before adding another pack.

Freeze one representative coding/research task with output, cancellation and edit-ownership checks; compare native single-agent and selected worker graph with complete returned usage and independent acceptance.
For the intended untrusted workload, compare the current sandbox with one OCI/VM candidate on filesystem/network/resource enforcement, state cleanup and host compatibility.
Seal representative target-language questions with exact source/reference answers; include index build/update cost and known-source reads in the comparison.
Seal a representative document corpus and relevance judgments; repeat randomized lexical/hybrid retrieval plus selected difficult-layout ingestion before changing defaults.
Freeze target-project questions and expected source spans; measure retrieval/watcher correctness, latency, memory and restore on the destination hardware.
Run source-grounded recall and abstention cases with scoped capture, useful-write quality, deletion and isolated restore; compare complete usage without duplicating memory owners.
Freeze required primary-source coverage and citation checks; add a crawler or research service only if current native retrieval demonstrably misses the requirement.
Repeat a matched task at equal quality with original-context recovery; include failed attempts and separate complete provider use from cache subsets and artifact estimates.
Evaluate semantic advice on fresh independently labeled task cases, retain uncertain disagreements and a safe negative control; do not tune on the existing eight-case diagnostic.
Use the installed CI skill when a real Actions check fails; qualify log recovery and repair. Add vulnerability tooling only for a defined artifact/database gap.
If jobs must survive host loss or long waits, qualify one durable scheduler against explicit effect/retry/cancellation/recovery cases and operating cost.
Choose deployment requirements first: local development, remote service or GPU job. Qualify one host/container option on data, network, rollback, persistence and measured workload cost.
On the destination PC, select a small profile; establish native sign-ins, scoped tool calls and useful tasks, then independently restore selected application state and keys.
Reconcile one real task across native counters and telemetry; qualify any new model route on actual output, privacy, latency and recovery without duplicate capture.
Create held-out finance/document/code relevance judgments; compare fidelity, abstention and total task cost while preserving source timestamps, project isolation and original recovery.
Exercise a chosen real research worker job end to end; preserve source packet, complete output, cancellation, process ownership and usage before extending scheduler or host scope.
Freeze the intended universe/history and rights; obtain auditable delisting, ticker-reuse, action/currency and publication-revision evidence before accepting an as-known research dataset.

Freeze retained SPY/LEAN order, fill, dividend and cash oracles; qualify Nautilus parity, then native in-flight failure/reconciliation separately for IBKR and Alpaca. Strategy qualification remains independent.
